newsitem.title: USA: Levitz renegotiating GE Capital deal.
newsitem.headline: Levitz renegotiating GE Capital deal.

text.p: Levitz Furniture Inc said on Monday that it and its wholly owned subsidiary, Levitz Furniture Corp, are renegotiating the terms of their account purchase agreement with General Electric Co's GE Capital unit regarding the purchase and sale of up to $900 million of Levitz's accounts receivable.

Levitz said in a news release that the negotiations may significantly impact its financial disclosure for fiscal 1997. The company filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a 15-day extension for filing its annual report.
